+
+# --- FIX: missing_column ---
+# The Bank Marketing dataset (UCI) is commonly semicolon-delimited.
+# If "y" is not found after loading with comma delimiter, retry with semicolon.
+# Also handle the case where the column may have been serialised with surrounding
+# whitespace or BOM characters by stripping all column names after load.
+def _load_csv_with_target(path: str, target_col: str = "y") -> pd.DataFrame:
+    """Try comma, then semicolon delimiter; strip column names; raise clearly if target absent."""
+    for sep in (",", ";", "\t", "|"):
+        try:
+            _df = pd.read_csv(path, encoding="utf-8", sep=sep)
+        except Exception:
+            try:
+                _df = pd.read_csv(path, encoding="latin-1", sep=sep)
+            except Exception:
+                continue
+        # Strip whitespace and BOM from column names
+        _df.columns = [c.strip().lstrip("\ufeff") for c in _df.columns]
+        if target_col in _df.columns:
+            return _df
+    # Last resort: load with python engine and sep=None (sniffs)
+    try:
+        _df = pd.read_csv(path, encoding="utf-8", sep=None, engine="python")
+        _df.columns = [c.strip().lstrip("\ufeff") for c in _df.columns]
+        if target_col in _df.columns:
+            return _df
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+    # If still not found, load with default and report available columns for diagnosis
+    _df = pd.read_csv(path, encoding="utf-8")
+    _df.columns = [c.strip().lstrip("\ufeff") for c in _df.columns]
+    raise KeyError(
+        f"FAILSAFE: target column '{target_col}' not found after trying multiple delimiters. "
+        f"Available columns: {list(_df.columns)}"
+    )
+
+df = _load_csv_with_target(_csv_path, target_col="y")
+# --- END FIX ---
